name: agent-handoff
description: Coordinate multi-agent AI development workflows via agent-handoff. Create ChangeSets, advance FSM states, and manage HITL approval gates.

endpoints.name: health_check
endpoints.description: Check if the agent-handoff server is running. No auth required.

endpoints.name: create_change_set
endpoints.description: Create a new ChangeSet with a title. Auto-generates the task ID, branch name, and worktree path. Returns the ChangeSet ID needed for subsequent calls.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Human-readable title for the task, e.g. 'Add rate limiting to POST /api/users'

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional extended description of the task.

endpoints.name: get_change_set
endpoints.description: Get a ChangeSet by ID. Use this to poll the FSM status. Status values: draft, planned, implementing, reviewing, changes_requested, approved, merged, conflict_detected, escalated, awaiting_human_approval, abandoned.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ChangeSet ID in chg_NNNNNN format, as returned by create_change_set

endpoints.name: advance_fsm
endpoints.description: Advance the ChangeSet FSM via a named trigger. Returns the updated ChangeSet, or 202 with approvalId when a HITL gate is hit (e.g. approve, merge). Available triggers: plan_accepted, assign_implementer, submit_for_review, request_changes, approve, pick_up_revision, merge, abandon.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: FSM trigger name. Common values: plan_accepted, assign_implementer, submit_for_review, approve, merge

endpoints.name: approve_hitl_gate
endpoints.description: Approve a pending HITL (human-in-the-loop) gate. Use the approvalId returned by a 202 response from advance_fsm.

parameters.name: approvalId
parameters.description: UUID returned in the approvalId field of a 202 response

parameters.name: decided_by
parameters.description: Identity of the approver, e.g. 'openclaw-skill' or a user name. Stored in the audit log.

endpoints.name: reject_hitl_gate
endpoints.description: Reject a pending HITL gate and return the ChangeSet to the previous state.

parameters.name: approvalId
parameters.description: UUID returned in the approvalId field of a 202 response

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Reason for rejection. Stored in the audit log.
